summary_1line: Bhima urges the grief-stricken Yudhishthira to rule, arguing that order requires chastisement and that he must conquer his inner sorrow like a warrior.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima, restraining his anger, stands before the despondent Yudhishthira in the royal hall and urges him to rise and rule.
Bhima evokes Draupadi being dragged into the assembly, her garments disheveled while the court watches in silence.
A symbolic vision of a warrior battling a shadowy enemy that emerges from his own mind.
